policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Division programs post 225 wins against outside opponents Across the national schedule, member sides added 54 draws and 141 losses in matches outside the division. Those programs scored 941 goals while conceding 541.
claims.note: against programmes outside the division — a match between two covered conferences is neither a win nor a loss for it
